exposure: complications in preceding stages of pregnancy
seeking antenatal care from health facilities and skilled personnel
seeking delivery assistance from health facilities and skilled personnel
cohort: The study includes 26,887 women aged 15-49 years who gave birth to their last child alive in the five years preceding the survey in Northeast India.
finding: The prevalence of intrapartum and postpartum complications is higher among women who had complications in preceding stages, with nulliparity, unwanted pregnancy, previous caesarean delivery, multiple births, and not attending antenatal care substantially increasing maternal morbidity risk.
mod_finding: Women with a caesarean delivery before their index pregnancy have a higher risk of subsequent maternal complications.
cross-section timing: Data from the fifth round of the National Family Health Survey, covering births in the five years preceding the survey.
